header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile, Start Game, then Start (Enter) through the logos, the opening and the title into Mario Land, and A
(Space) through Toad's greeting, the warp pipe and Rules Land into the board Toad teaches the rules on, as a player
does on a new save. Four computer players play it with the board engine: dice, spaces, a minigame's pick. Which
screen is up is the overlay omOvlGotoEx last went to, a word at 0x800FA63C: Mario Land is 0x5B, Rules Land 0x4D and
its board 0x4C; a need fails the run unless the game is on that board. The page has no prebuilt shader list yet, so
its first minutes stutter as RT64 builds each pipeline.
